info.name: Highway Rider
info.description: The Highway Rider subclass from Grim Hollow: Player's Guide (2025).
info.author: Ghostfire Gaming

description.p: A Steed Makes the Best Partner in Crime

Stalking the backroads, the Highway Rider strikes fear into the heart of every traveler and penny-pinching merchant. They run down their prize astride a swift and loyal steed—and then make a quick getaway.
You gain proficiency with Blackpowder Pistols. In addition, when you roll Initiative and don't have Disadvantage on that roll, you can immediately take a Reaction for one of the following options:

ul.li: Make one attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike.
Move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
A controlled mount moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Take the Dodge or Utilize action.

sheet.description: When you roll Initiative without Disadvantage, you can take a Reaction to do one of the following: make a weapon/Unarmed Strike attack, move your Speed without Opportunity Attacks, have a controlled mount move its Speed without Opportunity Attacks, or take the Dodge/Utilize action.

description.p: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared. With this feature, you can cast it without a spell slot or components, and your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence.
Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: You can cast Find Steed without a spell slot or components (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability).

description.p: You don't need Advantage on the attack roll to Sneak Attack if you or a controlled mount you ride moves at least 20 feet, and you don't have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

sheet.description: You don't need Advantage to Sneak Attack if you or your controlled mount moves at least 20 ft, and you don't have Disadvantage.

description.p: You can spend 1 minute grooming and caring for your mount, at the end of which it gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Rogue level.
In addition, your cunning extends to your steed. While you control a mount, it can take one of the following actions as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.

sheet.description: Spend 1 min grooming your mount to grant it {{horse lord:thp}} THP. While you control a mount, it can Dash, Disengage, or Dodge as a Bonus Action.

description.p: You gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws. In addition, when you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

sheet.description: When an effect allows a Con save for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

description.p: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you can use your Hair Trigger feature immediately before you fall Unconscious.

sheet.description: When reduced to 0 HP (not killed outright), you can use Hair Trigger immediately before falling Unconscious.
